content:
Hi, I'm happy to announce Tables, a Lean 4 library that brings dataframe operations to Lean, with the APIs compatible with the B2T2 benchmark.

https://github.com/pandaman64/tables

The main design goal is to provide a single Table type to represent a dataframe, minimizing the verbosity of juggling type constraints. At the same time, we can still state and prove dataframe invariants as Lean theorems, and feed those proofs into operations that require specific schema properties. The library also offers a fallible variant that performs runtime checks, if the properties are not known statically.

Help wanted: proofs are currently a bit clunky and often rely heavily on native_decide when reasoning about concrete tables. If you’re comfortable with tactics / proof automation, I’d love to collaborate on improving the proof UX!
